title: Cloud platforms
text: Designing and running platforms on AWS, GCP and Azure: migrating off legacy infrastructure, self-service provisioning and cloud cost visibility.

title: Kubernetes and GitOps
text: Highly available EKS clusters, Helm releases and ArgoCD GitOps deployments, plus Kubernetes on-prem and on Azure Kubernetes Service.

title: CI/CD and automation
text: Pipelines with blue/green and canary deployments and security and quality scanning early on, with infrastructure as code in Terraform, CloudFormation, Crossplane and Ansible.

title: Observability
text: Monitoring for 150+ microservices with Prometheus, Grafana and CloudWatch, alerting through PagerDuty, and 24/7 on-call with root cause analysis.
